# Creative Production Workflows

## Use when
The user asks to plan, create, revise, catalog, or prepare creative assets for Wicked Jester projects.

## Workflow
- Identify project, asset type, target platform, aspect ratio, and intended use from the request.
- Preserve source files and create clearly named working versions.
- Use connected creative tools only when available and authorized; do not claim an export or edit occurred unless confirmed by that service.
- Maintain a catalog with title, project/collection, version, format, dimensions, source location, rights/credit notes, and publication status.
- Keep previews separate from downloadable deliverables and published products.
- Do not publish, sell, or share an asset without explicit approval.

## Brand handling
Use the user's confirmed Wicked Jester naming and approved visual direction. Apply requested signature and watermark accurately; do not invent legal copyright registrations or ownership records.
